chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Muḥammad, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
"The believer remains within breadth in his religion so long as he does not shed forbidden blood."
And he said: "The killer of a believer is never granted success for repentance."

key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنُ: the believer; the person possessing iman
key_terms.دِينِهِ: his religion; his religious state and standing
key_terms.فِي فُسْحَةٍ: in a state of breadth or latitude, meaning spiritual room and relief
key_terms.لِلتَّوْبَةِ: for repentance; returning to Allah through remorse and turning back

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about killing a believer and repentance?
ai.summary: This hadith warns that a believer remains in spiritual latitude so long as he does not commit the grave sin of shedding unlawful blood. It further stresses the extreme seriousness of killing a believer by stating that such a killer is not granted divine success for repentance.
